name: Rotisserie Chicken, Butternut Squash & Bell Pepper Stir-Fry with Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and halve crosswise; slice each half into thin strips. Place in another medium bowl along with the butternut squash.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 red bell peppers
2 yellow bell peppers
4 cup frozen butternut squash, pieces

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper and squash.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, cover with a lid, and cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add chicken and stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken and sauce are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

ingredients.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
